user.title: Particle account
user.description: Paste a Particle access token. Create one that doesn't expire with `particle token create --never-expires` (Particle CLI). Events arrive live from the Particle Cloud event stream, so Home Assistant needs no public URL.

devices.title: Devices
devices.description: The account has {count} devices. Pick the ones Home Assistant should see. Cloud variables are read every poll interval (a cloud round trip each, which uses data on cellular devices); prefer `ha/<key>` events for live values.

reauth_confirm.title: New Particle token
reauth_confirm.description: Particle rejected the token. Paste a new one for the same account.

abort.already_configured: This Particle account is already set up.
abort.wrong_account: That token belongs to a different Particle account.

stream_down.title: Particle event stream down
stream_down.description: Home Assistant hasn't had a working Particle event stream for over {minutes} minutes, so device events and `ha/` sensors aren't updating. It keeps reconnecting by itself. Last error: {error}

call_function.name: Call function
call_function.description: Call a cloud function on a Particle device. Returns its integer return value.

publish_event.name: Publish event
publish_event.description: Publish a private event that the account's devices can subscribe to with Particle.subscribe().
